notes.title: Patch Notes ver 0.2.1
notes.notes:
・The action become more realistic when you climb up a ladder or cliff. If you gain more momentum, you can reach out higher place.
・Tuning up collision detection
・Fixing the sound problem in result screen
・Fixing other minor bugs

notes.title: Version 0.2.0 update information and Episode 2 had been added!!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33783733/f8d6a370bece784eb09f4e3100e91eaeeb6a5b18.png[/img]
Hello, all slayers!
We are very happy to announce early Xmas present for those who enjoy our TITAN SLAYER II.
Now the 【TITAN SLAYER II】had been updated and you can play whole new “Episode 2”.
For stage setting of new Episode, we had made a complete change from previous one. You can play in a deep woods and gloomy cave.
The final boss battle is really a tough one to deal with.
Play as hard as you can and aim for the top in a ranking.

■ Added contents
- Episode 2-1
- Episode 2-2
- 4 different Challenges for Episode 2
■ Improvement
- Impact range of muzzle flash is wider
- Improve more realistic feeling for enemies, weapons and environment sound
■ Bug fix
- Had fixed unintentional action when player attack some of enemies
- Had fixed the problem which in-game sound will stop when multiple sound played simultaneously

【TITAN SLAYER II】will improve more.
Keep playing and enjoy our game. Your feedback and comments are always welcome. 
The game will be improved more with your help!!

Have a wonderful Xmas!!

notes.title: Patch Notes ver 0.1.3
notes.notes:
・Changing the condition to unlock Challenge Mode
Every time you finish a stage, a Challenge mode will be unlocked.
More people can play in this way.
Aim for the top!

notes.title: Patch Notes ver0.1.2
notes.notes:
Hello, all slayers!!
As we had already informed, we release a patch to experience more comfortable game play.

　- You can select the way you hold your weapon. Holding trigger button or toggle the button to hold.
　- You can turn off blood from option menu.
　- Fix the issue which had landed in unexpected place when player fell off from the ladder.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33783733/5e8cb694b4f51e84fa898bac8d07de65423d7d7c.png[/img]

Your feedback and comments are always welcome to improve t【TITAN SLAYER Ⅱ】. Let’s make the great game together!

notes.title: Patch Note Ver 0.1.1
notes.notes:
Patch Notes Ver 0.1.1

Hello SLAYERS! We fixed the following bugs!

- Fixed typos in translation

· Fixed a bug about counting enemys in challenge stages

Please keep to enjoy TITAN SLAYERⅡ!
Thanks!

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS RELEASE!
notes.notes:
Time has come!
We are very happy to announce that the “TITAN SLAYER II” is now on site as Early Access!!
We had also launched “TITAN SLAYER ULTRA PACK” which is a better deal if you purchase “TITAN SLAYER” and ““TITAN SLAYER II” as a set.
Those who haven’t played “TITAN SLAYER” yet, this is THE DEAL for you.

We are planning to add new stage within this year and keep adding sub-quest, new weapons and more on later.
